title: Verify and bound Codex removed-environment-name overlays across thread resumes
outcome: Codex project-environment removal semantics are verified against thread/resume and do not retain unnecessary empty-string overrides indefinitely.
acceptance: Establish whether successful Codex thread resumes preserve prior shell_environment_policy.set values and document the supported removal behavior across providers.
Use existing thread setup owner to remove or bound stale configured-name overrides, preserving immutable active runtime selections and missing-value UNKNOWN behavior.
Behavioral fixtures cover configured, removed, subsequent resume and seeded/inherited-value interactions without a live service.
